about: External line & venue audit for the 2026-10-25 LoL card (session 154d8c26). Documents: (1) discovery and integration of UKGC-regulated Smarkets Exchange REST v3 JSON API (api.smarkets.com/v3/) across all 8 Worlds 2026 series; (2) independent verification of GosuGamers, Liquipedia Matches, Midnite (HTTP 200 soft-404), Strafe (HTTP 404), and Bmbets (reCAPTCHA wall).

sources.name: Smarkets (UKGC Exchange)
sources.runner_reachable: yes - public unauthenticated REST v3 JSON API at https://api.smarkets.com/v3/events/?state=new&state=upcoming&type=league_of_legends_match&limit=50
sources.note: UKGC-licensed peer-to-peer betting exchange. Exposes unauthenticated JSON endpoints for events, WINNER_2_WAY markets, contracts, and basis-point (10000 = 100%) bid/offer orderbook quotes. Integrated into tools/collect.py, tools/model.py, scripts/collect.mjs, and scripts/analyze.mjs.

sources.name: GosuGamers LoL Matches
sources.note: Established esports match portal; on 2026-10-25 its upcoming LoL schedule listed only Worlds 2026 Main Event and LGC Rising 2026 Playoffs (Vitality Rising Bees vs Mental Rush).

sources.name: Midnite
sources.runner_reachable: HTTP 200 soft-404 SPA error shell (fixed in tools/collect.py _is_soft_404)
sources.note: UKGC-licensed bookmaker; /esports/league-of-legends redirects to /sports/league-of-legends and renders a 'can’t find the page' soft-404 error.

sources.name: Strafe Esports Betting
sources.note: Returns 404 Page Not Found on its League of Legends betting hub.

sources.name: Bmbets Esports
sources.note: Multi-book comparison site; esports index gated behind a failing reCAPTCHA Enterprise challenge.

coverage_observations.observation: Smarkets' unauthenticated REST v3 JSON API returned 8 upcoming League of Legends match events (ids 45400319..45400326), all in Worlds 2026 Group/Swiss Stage, each with an open WINNER_2_WAY series market and active two-sided orderbook quotes (e.g. 45400319 Top Esports 4167/5208 bps vs G2 Esports 4762/5814 bps -> de-vigged 46.99% / 53.01%). Zero lower-tier regional, national, or amateur LoL competitions are listed on the exchange.

coverage_observations.observation: Midnite's League of Legends URL returns HTTP 200 after redirecting to /sports/league-of-legends, but the rendered SPA body is a 404 error notice rather than a betting coupon. tools/collect.py now detects this soft-404 body so Midnite is not counted as an active reachable LoL odds source.

Bmbets' esports odds comparison page served a reCAPTCHA challenge wall with a site-owner configuration/quota error instead of match odds.
